routes.name: Berkeley Fire Trail Loop
routes.summary: Classic UC Berkeley undergrad trail run. Dirt fire road climb with city + Bay views from Grizzly Peak. Loop back via Centennial.
routes.best_time: Sunset for Bay views; early morning for shade.

routes.name: Lake Merritt Loop
routes.summary: 3.4-mile flat loop around Oakland's Lake Merritt. Necklace of lights, paddle boats, locals everywhere.

routes.name: Marina Green to Crissy Field
routes.summary: SF's postcard run: out-and-back along the bay with the Golden Gate Bridge looming. Wind off the water keeps you cool.

routes.name: Mission Bay Loop
routes.summary: Loop through Mission Bay along the waterfront. Modern, breezy, lots of foot traffic.
routes.best_time: After work, energy of the neighborhood is good.

routes.name: Tilden Skyline Trail
routes.summary: Big day. Single-track ridge running with Bay views. Bring water, bring headphones, expect deer.

routes.name: Wildcat Canyon (bike)
routes.summary: Climb Marin Ave, drop into Wildcat Canyon Rd. Steep hairpins, technical descents — go before the cyclists arrive.

routes.name: Skyline Boulevard (bike)
routes.summary: Long rolling cruise along Skyline Blvd. Redwood canopy + ocean glimpses. Pack a sandwich.

routes.name: Iron Horse Trail
routes.summary: Paved rail-trail through Walnut Creek / Danville. Flat, family-friendly, surprisingly meditative.

routes.name: Mt Hamilton via Quimby
routes.summary: Quimby is the spicy way up Hamilton — short, brutal switchbacks with sheer drop-offs. Lick Observatory is the bonus at the top.
routes.best_time: Clear weekday mornings. Sunset at Lick is unreal.

routes.name: Skyline Boulevard (drive)
routes.summary: CA-35 spine of the Peninsula. Long, scenic, well-paved. Iconic NorCal driving road.
routes.best_time: Saturday early afternoon — light traffic, golden light.

routes.name: Panoramic Highway
routes.summary: Mt Tam loop down to Stinson Beach. Tight technical sections, ocean drops out below you.
routes.best_time: Weekday morning — weekends are clogged with cyclists.

routes.name: Silverado Trail
routes.summary: Smooth wine-country sweepers from Napa to Calistoga. Less crowded than the parallel CA-29.
routes.best_time: Late afternoon — golden hour over the vineyards.

routes.name: Berkeley Marina Sunset Walk
routes.summary: Flat marina walk with the entire SF skyline framed by the Golden Gate. Dogs everywhere.

routes.name: Lands End Trail
routes.summary: Coastal trail past shipwrecks and the Golden Gate, ending at Sutro Baths ruins.
routes.best_time: Foggy mornings have the most atmosphere.
